segments.title: A return to Mikasa during repair work
segments.summary: A solo rail trip from Shinagawa ends with another look at Mikasa, a much-anticipated visit and possible highlight of the Japan trip despite the scaffolding and repair work.
segments.body: This short travel update begins with the convenience of using Shinagawa as a base for rail journeys. The destination is Mikasa, a ship whose visit had been anticipated long before the journey to Japan and may have been the trip's highlight. The description of historic warships as individual "ladies" with style, grace, and presence conveys the personal appeal of seeing a preserved vessel in person. Earlier videos establish the location, and this return visit is made alone. Construction and repair work still surround Mikasa, leaving her partly covered in scaffolding. The work does not lessen the pleasure of seeing the ship again and shows that the preserved vessel is receiving ongoing care.

evidence.note: Dr. Clarke travels from Shinagawa, identifies Mikasa at 1:38, and describes ongoing repair work and his return visit.
